newsitem.title: PERU: Peru 28-day CDs draw 14.74 pct avg yield at sale.
newsitem.headline: Peru 28-day CDs draw 14.74 pct avg yield at sale.

text.p: The Central Reserve Bank of Peru said Wednesday it accepted bids for 28-day Certificates of Deposit (CDs) worth 22.7 million soles at an effective average annual rate of 14.74 percent during a bank auction.
The CDs have a November 14 starting date.
The accepted bids had a minimum rate of 14.00 percent and a maximum rate of 15.00 percent, the bank said.
At the last CD auction November 13, 43-day CDs drew an average yield of 14.50 percent.
At Wednesday's auction, the bank said it received bids on the CDs totalling 49.2 million soles.
The bank had offered 20 million soles worth of CDs.
The average effective annual interest rate for the certificates is used as an informal indicator for interest rates in the Peruvian financial system.
